exactIssue: When a non-Mission-Control worker can see exact owner-message text but the conversation surface exposes no durable provider locator and no independent Extra High or Mission Control collector, does a deterministic byte receipt over a worker-copied exact source block satisfy the independent owner-source requirement for reversible contributing work and task supervision? What stronger fail-closed state is required for root completion or release?

relevantRule.section: 3. Pro must not depend on GitHub access or a laundered contract / 11. Current-worker receipt
relevantRule.excerpt: The owner source must be supplied independently by Mission Control, deterministic tooling, or an Extra High reader—not only through the worker's polished handoff.

observedOrHypotheticalFailure: Treating a worker-copied source block as fully independent could allow an accidental omission or transcription error to pass a deterministic hash and later support a false root-completion or release claim. Treating it as unusable in all cases could stall safe reversible work even when exact owner text is visible and limitations are explicit.
proposedChange: Define graded receipt capability: deterministic exact-text capture with no provider locator may support reversible contributing work and nonterminal task supervision when marked with explicit limitations, but must yield SOURCE_MISSING or PARTIAL for root completion, release, publication, deployment, or irreversible action until independently retrieved provider bytes or an owner re-attestation is available.
alternativesConsidered: Treat any deterministic hash as fully independent regardless of source acquisition.
Block all work until a provider-side durable locator or separate reader is available.
Ask the owner to restate every active task solely to manufacture a fresh receipt.
risks: A permissive interpretation could reintroduce contract laundering through source capture.
An absolute block could create unnecessary owner burden and halt harmless reversible work.
Project-local workarounds could fragment the universal supervision architecture.
workerRecommendation: Adopt the graded capability rule and require the limitation to be visible in every Pro packet until independent retrieval or owner re-attestation closes it.
workerUncertainty: The phrase 'deterministic tooling' may already intend to cover this exact capture path, but the independence boundary between acquisition and hashing is not explicit.
decisionThatCanChange: Whether this owner-source receipt supports MATCH for nonterminal reversible task supervision and what state it permits for root completion or release.
